subject.title: 一个现实的问题，很多人将面临无法访问github

question: Should this be handled as external-service promotion/support noise, or should maintainers ask the reporter to restate it as a scoped ClawHub GitHub-access/auth requirement?
rationale: The issue lacks a reproducible ClawHub failure and the only concrete link is an external VPN registration URL, while any alternate-auth or regional-access interpretation would require product and security direction.

options.title: Treat as off-topic support/promotion
options.body: A maintainer can close or moderate manually unless the reporter provides a concrete ClawHub command, page, error, and environment.

options.title: Ask for a scoped reproduction
options.body: Keep it open only if maintainers want reporter details for a specific ClawHub login, CLI, or publishing failure.

options.title: Open a product direction thread
options.body: If the intended request is non-GitHub auth or regional access, move it into a separate product/security issue with explicit requirements.

recommendation.title: Treat as off-topic support/promotion
recommendation.body: A maintainer can close or moderate manually unless the reporter provides a concrete ClawHub command, page, error, and environment.

likelyOwner.reason: Current auth and CLI access surface history makes this the best available routing candidate for deciding whether this belongs in ClawHub product scope.
